ingredient.water.name: Water
ingredient.water.description: From the pump in the yard. Costs nothing, cures nothing, fills a bottle.
ingredient.grain_alcohol.name: Grain Alcohol
ingredient.grain_alcohol.description: Rectified spirit: drinking alcohol, nearly pure. Warms the throat, loosens the tongue, and keeps a tincture from spoiling.
ingredient.sugar_syrup.name: Sugar Syrup
ingredient.sugar_syrup.description: Simple syrup to make the medicine go down.
ingredient.peppermint_oil.name: Oil of Peppermint
ingredient.peppermint_oil.description: A few drops hide a multitude of sins.
ingredient.gentian.name: Gentian Root
ingredient.gentian.description: A bitter root, ground for tonics. Fiercely bitter: customers are convinced that anything this unpleasant must be working.
ingredient.capsicum.name: Capsicum
ingredient.capsicum.description: Red pepper. A warming sensation the customer can feel, at the cost of a penny.
ingredient.aloe.name: Bitter Aloes
ingredient.aloe.description: The dried juice of the aloe plant: a powerful purgative, which empties the bowels. The customer will certainly feel that something has happened.
ingredient.laudanum.name: Laudanum
ingredient.laudanum.description: Tincture of opium: opium dissolved in spirit. Soothes every complaint, and brings the customer back for more.
ingredient.morphine.name: Morphine
ingredient.morphine.description: The drug in opium, purified to a white powder. A little goes a very long way.
ingredient.coca_extract.name: Fluid Extract of Coca
ingredient.coca_extract.description: Coca leaf soaked in spirit: the leaf cocaine is made from, and far milder. The fashionable new stimulant: banishes fatigue and melancholy alike.
ingredient.calomel.name: Calomel
ingredient.calomel.description: A mercury salt, the physician's standby purge. It empties the bowels, and the mercury stays in the body.
ingredient.fowlers_solution.name: Fowler's Solution
ingredient.fowlers_solution.description: Arsenic dissolved in water, sold as a respectable tonic. Brightens the complexion, for a while.
ingredient.sulfuric_acid_dilute.name: Dilute Sulphuric Acid
ingredient.sulfuric_acid_dilute.descript: Oil of vitriol, a few drops to the pint of water, bought by the carboy from the chemical works. A sour tang that tells the customer the microbes are being killed.
ingredient.acetanilide.name: Acetanilide
ingredient.acetanilide.description: A new coal-tar powder for headache and fever, from the German dye works. Hard on the heart.
ingredient.heroin.name: Heroin
ingredient.heroin.description: A new drug made from morphine, sold for coughs, and said to be free of morphine's drawbacks.
ingredient.aspirin.name: Aspirin
ingredient.aspirin.description: A new analgesic that actually relieves pain without killing anybody.
process.simple_mix.name: Simple Mixture
process.steep.name: Steeping
process.steep.description: The roots and herbs soak in the spirit for a week, like tea left in the pot: a stronger, more bitter tincture.
process.percolate.name: Percolation
process.percolate.description: Spirit dripped slowly through the ground drugs, as through a coffee pot, draws out more of them: stronger, more bitter, and a little more habit-forming.
unlock.second_still.name: A Second Still
unlock.second_still.description: Two brews a month instead of one, once the house has sold two hundred bottles.
unlock.percolator.name: The Percolator
unlock.percolator.description: A glass percolator: spirit dripped slowly through the ground drugs draws out more of them than a plain mixture does.
unlock.newspaper_ads.name: Newspaper Advertising
unlock.newspaper_ads.description: With savings in hand and a testimonial to print, the papers will take your money.
unlock.doctor_title.name: "Doctor"
unlock.doctor_title.description: A title for your name, earned or otherwise. The ward thinks better of you, and the type case now holds a new claim: Endorsed by Eminent Physicians.
unlock.third_still.name: A Third Still
unlock.third_still.description: A third copper in the back room, once the house has sold six hundred bottles. The back room is becoming a works.
event.grateful_letter.title: A Grateful Letter
event.grateful_letter.body: A customer writes that your tonic restored her to health after three doctors failed. She would be honoured to see her words in print.
event.diploma_mill.title: A Medical Education, by Post
event.diploma_mill.body: A circular from a 'college of eclectic medicine' in Ohio offers a diploma for fifty dollars, no attendance required.
event.sanitary_inspector.title: The Sanitary Inspector
event.sanitary_inspector.body: A man from the Board of Health is looking at your back room and frowning. He mentions that his inspections can take a very long time.
event.sanitary_inspector.choice.pay_fee: Pay him three dollars for his trouble.
event.rival_shop_opens.title: A Rival on the Corner
event.rival_shop_opens.body: A new druggist has opened two doors down, with a window full of bottles very like yours.
event.rival_shop_opens.choice.spread_rum: Let it be known that his stock is adulterated.
timeline.antifebrin.headline: New Coal-Tar Remedy for Fever
timeline.antifebrin.body: German chemists offer acetanilide, sold as Antifebrin, for headache and fever.
timeline.ladies_journal_ad_ban.headline: Ladies' Journal Bars Patent Medicine Advertising
timeline.ladies_journal_ad_ban.body: A leading women's magazine announces it will no longer print advertisements for patent medicines.
timeline.rural_free_delivery.headline: Free Mail Delivery Comes to the Countryside
timeline.rural_free_delivery.body: The Post Office begins delivering letters and parcels directly to farms.
timeline.heroin_marketed.headline: A Heroic New Cough Remedy
timeline.heroin_marketed.body: A German firm begins marketing heroin for coughs and consumption.
timeline.aspirin_marketed.headline: New Analgesic Registered
timeline.aspirin_marketed.body: A remedy for pain and fever, aspirin, is registered and offered to physicians.
timeline.poison_squad.headline: The 'Poison Squad' Sits Down to Dinner
timeline.poison_squad.body: Government chemists are feeding young volunteers common preservatives to see what they do to the body.
timeline.great_american_fraud.headline: "The Great American Fraud"
timeline.great_american_fraud.body: A national weekly begins a series exposing the contents of popular patent medicines. Your trade is the subject.
timeline.pure_food_and_drug_act.headline: Congress Passes the Pure Food and Drug Act
timeline.pure_food_and_drug_act.body: From the first of January next, alcohol, opium, morphine, cocaine and other drugs must be declared on the label.
background.druggist.name: The Druggist
background.druggist.description: A trained hand in the laboratory, with modest savings and no gift for publicity.
background.showman.name: The Showman
background.showman.description: A born talker with a thin wallet and a casual attitude to measurement.

ailment.nerves.name: Nerves

ailment.neuralgia.name: Neuralgia
ailment.cough.name: A persistent cough
ailment.melancholy.name: Melancholy
ailment.insomnia.name: Sleeplessness
ailment.female_complaints.name: Female complaints
ailment.catarrh.name: Catarrh
ailment.consumption.name: Consumption
cause.event.trade_lost: Trade given up to answer letters
unlock.coroner_fees.name: The Coroner's Consulting Fee
unlock.coroner_fees.description: Having survived one inquest, you have learned that the coroner is a practical man. Future inquests can be settled privately.
unlock.quality_control.name: Quality Control
unlock.quality_control.description: An assistant tests each batch. Bad batches are caught and poured away before they reach a customer.
unlock.larger_shop.name: The Shop Next Door
unlock.larger_shop.description: The wall to the shop next door is down: room for twenty more regular customers.
unlock.bulk_supplier.name: A Wholesale Supplier
unlock.bulk_supplier.description: A drug importer on Pearl Street will sell to you at fifteen per cent off.
event.inquest.title: Inquest into the Death of {name}
event.inquest.body: The coroner has convened a jury to inquire into the death of {name}, who was known to take your medicine. The jury sits this month.
event.inquest.choice.testify: Testify to the purity of your preparations.
event.inquest.choice.stay_silent: Keep your head down and say nothing.
event.temperance_picket.title: The Temperance Ladies
event.temperance_picket.body: A dozen ladies of the Women's Christian Temperance Union are singing hymns outside your door and handing out tracts about your 'poison'.
event.temperance_picket.choice.donate: Make a donation of five dollars to their cause.
event.board_of_health.title: The Board of Health
event.board_of_health.body: Inspectors have come with a warrant. They are prepared to overlook matters for a fine of thirty dollars, or they will take every bottle on your shelves for analysis.
event.customer_wants_stronger.title: Something Stronger
event.customer_wants_stronger.body: One of your regulars leans across the counter. The tonic isn't doing what it used to. Is there anything stronger?
claim.soothes_nerves.name: Soothes the Nerves
claim.purifies_the_blood.name: Purifies the Blood
claim.womens_friend.name: Woman's Best Friend
claim.teething_comfort.name: Comfort for Teething Babes
claim.banishes_rheumatism.name: Banishes Rheumatism
claim.cures_consumption.name: Cures Consumption
claim.cures_everything.name: Cures Consumption, Cholera, Melancholy and Bad Temper
claim.endorsed_by_physicians.name: Endorsed by Eminent Physicians
verdict.visitation_of_god: Died by the Visitation of God
verdict.excess_of_spite: Died of an Excess of Spite
verdict.proprietary_poisoning: Died of poisoning by a proprietary medicine
cause.body.complaints: Complaints from regulars and their families
cause.advertising.claims: Bold claims on the label and in the paper
cause.advertising.cure_claims: Labels that claim to cure a deadly disease
cause.scrutiny.broken_promise: A customer died of what the label claimed to cure
ingredient.valerian.name: Valerian Root
ingredient.valerian.description: An old remedy for nerves and sleeplessness. Mildly calming, habit-free, and smells of old socks.
event.rival_price_war.title: A Price War
event.rival_price_war.body: Feeney, two doors down, has put his tonic in the window at 65 cents a bottle, under your price, with a card thanking you for paying him no mind when he opened. For four months he will take two in five of the passing trade whose bottle costs more than his, unless you answer him.
event.rival_price_war.choice.handbills: Answer him with handbills of your own, for $10.
event.rival_price_war.choice.cry_him_dow: Let it be known his stock is chalk and creek water.
event.rival_price_war.choice.let_him_try: Let him try. At 65 cents or under, he takes nothing from you.
event.rival_price_war_slander.title: A Price War
event.rival_price_war_slander.body: Feeney, two doors down, has put his tonic in the window at 65 cents a bottle, under your price, with a card answering what you told the ward of his stock. For four months he will take two in five of the passing trade whose bottle costs more than his, unless you answer him.
event.rival_price_war_slander.choice.han: Answer him with handbills of your own, for $10.
event.rival_price_war_slander.choice.cry: Let it be known again: chalk and creek water, at any price.
event.rival_price_war_slander.choice.let: Let him try. At 65 cents or under, he takes nothing from you.
event.landlord_rent.title: The Landlord Calls
event.landlord_rent.body: Your landlord has noticed the trade. The rent goes up by a dollar a month, starting with this month's, and it stays up. He would sell you the lease outright for sixty dollars, and there is a narrower shop across the street at a dollar under the old rent.
event.landlord_rent.choice.pay_the_rise: Pay the extra dollar a month.
event.landlord_rent.choice.smaller_premi: Move across the street: a dollar under the old rent, with room for eight fewer regulars.
event.landlord_rent.choice.buy_the_lease: Buy the lease for $60: the rent falls by a dollar a month, for good.
event.spirits_dearer.title: Spirits Are Dearer
event.spirits_dearer.body: Your wholesaler writes that the distillers of the West have pooled their output, and grain spirit will cost twice its old price for six months from your acknowledgment. A Jersey distiller outside the ring will supply at the old price, for six dollars down.
event.spirits_dearer.choice.pay_the_new_: Acknowledge the new price: spirit at double for six months.
event.spirits_dearer.choice.outside_dist: Pay the Jersey man $6 and keep the old price.
event.benefit_society.title: The Benefit Society
event.benefit_society.body: One of your regulars is secretary of a mutual-aid society. For a subscription of $1.50 a month for a year, the society will send its members to your counter: about five more callers a month.
event.benefit_society.choice.subscribe: Subscribe for the year: $1.50 a month, five more callers a month.
cause.sales.wholesale: Sales to druggists out of town
cause.sales.craving: Paid over the price by regulars who crave it
investment.branch_shop.name: A Branch in Another Ward
investment.branch_shop.description: A second counter across town, with a clerk and its own regulars: twenty more can call it their shop, and a dozen strangers a month look in. The rent is due whether they buy or not.
investment.shop_next_door.name: The Shop Next Door
investment.shop_next_door.description: The shop next door stands empty. The landlord will let you both, and take down the wall between, for three dollars more a month, for as long as you keep it: room for twenty more regulars. The old shop holds thirty, so it pays only once they are all coming. Offered once twenty-five regulars call the shop their own.
investment.larger_copper.name: A Larger Copper
investment.larger_copper.description: The coppersmith on Elm street will put a larger pot on every still in the back room: seventy-two bottles a batch instead of forty-eight, on every still the house has or adds. Offered once the second still is in.
investment.fourth_still.name: A Fourth Still
investment.fourth_still.description: A fourth copper, bought new from the coppersmith and set up in the yard, with a boy to mind the fire at three dollars a month. Offered once the third still is in and the house has sold two thousand bottles.
investment.almanac.name: The Proprietor's Almanac
investment.almanac.description: Ten thousand almanacs, with the moon's phases, a recipe for pickles and every claim on your label, left on kitchen tables across the city. For a year: ten callers a month who never read a newspaper, a dozen bottles a month sent for by post, and every claim in print.
investment.druggists_order.name: A Druggist's Standing Order
investment.druggists_order.description: A druggist over in Brooklyn will take a dozen or more bottles a month for his own shelf, at a little over half your price (never more than fifty cents a bottle), and more the better your name. He sells them on at your price, so a dear bottle sells fewer. His bottles are put up after your regulars are served, from what is left on the shelf, and he reads the papers.
investment.wholesale_contract.name: A Wholesale Contract
investment.wholesale_contract.descriptio: Druggists in Paterson, Newark and Elizabeth will take your bottles by the dozen every month, at a little over half your price (never more than fifty cents a bottle), and more of them the better your name. They read the papers: once the talk turns ugly, they cancel.
investment.laboratory.name: A Laboratory
investment.laboratory.description: A back room fitted with retorts and a German chemist who asks no questions. Opium, morphine and coca bought crude and worked up on the premises, at a quarter of the druggist's price. The chemist draws wages, and ether is apt to catch.
event.landlord_roof.title: The Roof Over the Still
event.landlord_roof.body: The roof over your back room has let in the rain all winter, and I am told it now drips into your copper. I will mend it when the spring rents are in. If you would rather not wait on me, a slate man of my acquaintance will do it for five dollars, or I will do it now for fifty cents more on the rent until next year.
event.landlord_roof.choice.pay_slater: Pay the slate man five dollars.
event.landlord_roof.choice.rent_it: Take the landlord's offer: fifty cents more on the rent for a year.
event.landlord_roof.choice.pan_under: Put a pan under the drip.
event.doctor_arrangement.title: A Physician Proposes
event.doctor_arrangement.body: Half the patients in my waiting room come with one of your bottles in their coat. I propose that we stop competing for them. I shall send you my prescriptions to fill, and you will send me the coughs your tonic does not touch, and a commission of one dollar a month, which is customary between gentlemen and need not be mentioned to the patients.
event.doctor_arrangement.choice.accept: Agree, and send him the dollar each month.
event.doctor_arrangement.choice.decline: Decline: your customers may go to whom they please.
event.parish_bazaar.title: The Parish Bazaar
event.parish_bazaar.body: The ladies of the parish hold their bazaar on the fourteenth of next month, for the roof fund. A dozen of your bottles for the raffle would be gratefully received, and announced from the pulpit, which is more than the newspapers can promise you. A dollar would also be gratefully received, though not announced.
event.parish_bazaar.choice.donate_dozen: Send a dozen bottles for the raffle, three dollars' worth, with your card.
event.police_collection.title: The Captain's Outing
event.police_collection.body: The Captain is getting up the anual outing of the precinct, steamboat to College Point with a band and a chowder. Druggists on this beat mostly give five dollars, and there back rooms mostly get left alone. I will call Friday.
event.police_collection.choice.give_five: Give him five dollars on Friday.
event.police_collection.choice.refuse: Tell him your back room is open to the Captain any day.
event.gazette_canvasser.title: A Reading Notice
event.gazette_canvasser.body: You are not ready for display space, but you are ready for a reading notice: three lines among the news, in the same type as the news, so that the reader takes it for news. Four dollars for two weeks. Our readers believe everything in the news columns, which is why the news columns are dear.
event.gazette_canvasser.choice.buy_notic: Take the reading notice for four dollars.
event.gazette_canvasser.choice.wait: Wait until you can afford the honest kind.
event.board_of_pharmacy.title: The Board of Pharmacy
event.board_of_pharmacy.body: Every person who compounds medicines in this city must be entered on the Board's register, by examination or by proof of former practice, on pain of a fine of fifty dollars. The register is being revised, and your name is not on it. The fee for registration is five dollars; the Board sits on the first Tuesday.
event.board_of_pharmacy.choice.register: Go before the Board and pay the five dollars.
event.board_of_pharmacy.choice.buy_certi: Buy a certificate from a man who knows the Board's clerk.
event.board_of_pharmacy.choice.file_it: File it with the other circulars.
event.blizzard_1888.title: The Snow
event.blizzard_1888.body: The snow lies to the first-floor sills and no coal or milk has come into the ward since Monday. Families in the rear houses are burning their chairs, and the children have coughs. The Committee asks the shops of the ward to give credit until the thaw, and will remember which did.
event.blizzard_1888.choice.raise_prices: Put the chest rub up to a dollar while the snow lasts.
event.grippe_1889.title: The Russian Influenza
event.grippe_1889.body: Every house in the city has the grippe, and every druggist is asked for a preventive. We can offer placards printed to your name, A SURE PREVENTIVE OF THE RUSSIAN INFLUENZA, as supplied to the trade from Boston to Baltimore, at two dollars the hundred. We do not say that it prevents the influenza. The placard says so.
event.grippe_1889.choice.placards: Order the placards and put one in the window.
event.grippe_1889.choice.bed_rest: Put up your own card: Go to bed, and send for the doctor.
event.jobber_exclusive.title: Terms of Exclusive Dealing
event.jobber_exclusive.body: We should like to be your only house. Sign with us for a year, and every drug and spirit on our list will be charged to you at a tenth off. We ask only that you buy nothing elsewhere for the year, and a deposit of ten dollars against the account, which is returned at the end of the world.
event.jobber_exclusive.choice.sign: Sign for the year, and pay the deposit.
event.jobber_exclusive.choice.stay_free: Stay free to buy where you like.
event.medicine_show_offer.title: A Medicine Show for the Summer
event.medicine_show_offer.body: My company takes the road on the first of May: a banjoist, a strong man, a lady who sings the old songs, and myself, who lectures upon the Blood. We play the canal towns from Albany to Buffalo and sell the evening's remedy from the tail of the wagon. For fifteen dollars toward the wagon and a third of the take, this summer's remedy could be yours.
event.medicine_show_offer.choice.sign_on: Send the fifteen dollars and a crate of labels.
event.medicine_show_offer.choice.decline: Decline: you have seen the strong man.
event.medicine_show_returns.title: The Professor Returns
event.medicine_show_returns.body: The company is back in winter quarters, less the strong man, who married in Utica; his brother has the dumb-bells for next season. Your fifteen dollars and your labels went from Albany to Buffalo and back. Your third of the summer's take comes to thirty-one dollars, less eight for breakages and two for the lady's dentist, which I am sure you will not begrudge her. I enclose twenty-one dollars, and remain your partner in the cause of the Blood.
event.medicine_show_returns.choice.take_: Take the twenty-one dollars, with thanks.
event.medicine_show_returns.choice.ask_f: Write that you would like to see the books, and the breakages.
event.kehoe_thanks.title: From the Top Floor
event.kehoe_thanks.body: The bottle of your tonic my husband had for his chest did him a power of good, and he is back at the docks. I have told the women at the pump. The baby is cutting her teeth and none of us have slept since Easter, and Mrs. Doyle says you keep something for that too.
event.kehoe_thanks.choice.send_syrup: Send up a bottle of soothing syrup from Hobart's for the baby, with your compliments.
event.kehoe_thanks.choice.send_to_dispen: Write that she should rub the gums with a cold spoon and take the baby to the dispensary.
event.kehoe_more.title: Mrs. Kehoe Writes Again
event.kehoe_more.body: The syrup you sent up is a blessing. Nora sleeps the day through now and hardly cries, even for her feed. Only it wants a spoonful more each week to do it, and the bottle is gone in four days. Could you get her a stronger one, so it lasts?
event.kehoe_more.choice.stronger: Send a stronger bottle, at the same price.
event.kehoe_more.choice.warn_her: Write that the baby must have no more of it, and fetch the dispensary doctor yourself.
event.kehoe_more.choice.same_again: Send the same bottle, and say nothing.
event.kehoe_last.title: A Note from the Top Floor
event.kehoe_last.body: Mrs. Kehoe asks me to write, as she is not able. The baby could not be woken on Tuesday. The dispensary doctor walked her up and down all night and she is living, and he asked what she had been given, and Mrs. Kehoe showed him the last bottle you sent up. She does not blame you, she says. She wanted you to know, and she sends the bottle back.
event.kehoe_last.choice.pay_doctor: Send ten dollars for the doctor, and no more syrup.
event.kehoe_last.choice.see_the_doctor: Call on the doctor, and ask him what twenty-five dollars would make it.
event.kehoe_well.title: Nora Walks
event.kehoe_well.body: Nora's teeth are through and she is walking, into everything. I did as you wrote, the cold spoon and the dispensary, and the dispensary doctor asked who sent me, and when I said the druggist on Mulberry Street he said that was a first. My husband's chest is still good. I send my thanks, and Mrs. Doyle's custom, and her sister's.
event.kehoe_well.choice.ask_to_print: Ask whether you may print her letter.
event.kehoe_well.choice.thank_her: Send your thanks, and a stick of candy for Nora.
event.stowe_tract.title: A Question from the League
event.stowe_tract.body: The League is compiling a list of the remedies sold in this ward, with the proportion of spirit in each, for the instruction of mothers. I enclose a ruled sheet. We should be obliged if you would fill in the line against your remedy truthfully, as the Lord will read it before we do.
event.stowe_tract.choice.purely_vegetabl: Write PURELY VEGETABLE across the sheet.
event.stowe_tract.choice.wrap_a_bottle: Use the sheet to wrap a bottle.
event.ward_boss_favor.title: Compliments of the Alderman
event.ward_boss_favor.body: The Alderman has heard good of your store and wants you should have no trouble from the Sanitary Bureau or anybody. All he asks is his picture in your window come November, and that you remember who your friends are. Say the word to me at Kelly's any night.
event.ward_boss_favor.choice.picture: Put the Alderman's picture in the window.
event.ward_boss_favor.choice.decline: Thank him, and keep the window for your own bottles.
event.ward_boss_due.title: Election Day
event.ward_boss_due.body: Election day is the Tuesday after the first Monday, as usual. The Alderman has seen his picture in your window and has not forgotten it. He wants six dozen bottles of your tonic for the boys who work the polls, on the house, and a dollar a head for some gentlemen who vote early and often, which the Alderman will pay back in his own way. Also your vote, and the votes of anybody who owes you money.
event.ward_boss_due.choice.supply: Send the bottles and the dollars.
event.ward_boss_due.choice.bottles_only: Send the bottles, but not the dollars.
event.ward_boss_due.choice.refuse: Tell him you vote as you please.
event.feeney_boy.title: Your Errand Boy
event.feeney_boy.body: Mr Feeney offers me fifty cents a week more than you to sweep his shop, and says I need not sweep much if I can tell him what goes in your big jug. I said I would ask you first. I am a honest boy but I am also fourteen.
event.feeney_boy.choice.raise: Give him the fifty cents a week.
event.feeney_boy_slander.title: Your Errand Boy
event.feeney_boy_slander.body: Mr Feeney offers me fifty cents a week more than you to sweep his shop, and says I need not sweep much if I can tell him what goes in your big jug, so he can show the ward whose stock is adulterated. I said I would ask you first. I am a honest boy but I am also fourteen.
event.feeney_boy_slander.choice.raise: Give him the fifty cents a week.
event.feeney_copy.title: Feeney's Own
event.feeney_copy.body: FEENEY'S OWN FAMILY REMEDY, prepared from the receipt of a celebrated Mulberry street druggist, whose name we are too modest to mention. The very same, at forty-five cents! Ask for it by name. — J. Feeney
event.feeney_copy.choice.lawyer: Put the matter in a lawyer's hands.
event.feeney_copy.choice.cry_imitation: Let it be known that his copy is a dangerous imitation.
event.feeney_copy.choice.let_him: Let him: his copy is only a copy.
event.feeney_inquest.title: Feeney's Copy
event.feeney_inquest.body: A jury has sat upon a lodger in Baxter street who died after a bottle of Feeney's Own. Mr. Feeney testified that the receipt was yours and that he followed it to the letter, except for the parts he could not read, which he made up. The Coroner invites you to say whether this is so.
event.feeney_inquest.choice.disown: Testify that Feeney cannot read your writing, or anything else.
event.feeney_inquest.choice.buy_feeney_o: Buy Feeney's shop and his bottles, and close it.
event.pawn_ticket.title: A Pawn Ticket
event.pawn_ticket.body: A customer of yours pledged a wedding ring with me on Saturday for one dollar and a half, and asked that the ticket be sent to you against her account, which she says is owing for the stronger preparation you promised her. I enclose it. The pledge runs three months at three per cent a month, which is the legal rate, and I keep to it.
event.pawn_ticket.choice.redeem_it: Redeem the ring and send it back to her, the account cleared.
event.pawn_ticket.choice.sell_ticket: Sell the ticket back to the pawnbroker.
event.pawn_ticket.choice.drawer: Put the ticket in the drawer with the others.
event.widow_account.title: An Account Outstanding
event.widow_account.body: I write for the family of one of your regulars, who died this year with your tonic by the bed, and owing you on it: your book will have the figure, which I have not the heart to look at. We have a watch, which the pawnbroker values at three dollars, and the children's shoes, which we would rather keep. We will pay what we can when we can, if you will tell us what that should be.
event.widow_account.choice.close_account: Write that the account is closed.
event.widow_account.choice.ten_cents: Ask for ten cents a week.
event.soda_fountain_offer.title: A Soda Fountain
event.soda_fountain_offer.body: Every druggist of standing now draws soda, and the man who doesn't sends his customers across the street for it, where they buy their pills as well. Our six-syrup marble fountain with silver-plated draught arm, installed complete, is sixty dollars. Sarsaparilla, lemon, vanilla, and a celery tonic that will quiet the nerves of the city.
event.soda_fountain_offer.choice.decline: Decline: the shop is a pharmacy, not a parlour.
event.undertaker.title: A Proposal from the Undertaker
event.undertaker.body: We serve the same families, you and I, at different stages. When a family of yours has need of me I should be glad of your recommendation, and when a family of mine is at the beginning of its trouble I could mention your tonic, which I have seen at a great many bedsides. A small commission either way would be usual.
event.electric_light.title: An Electric Window
event.electric_light.body: Our mains now run beneath Mulberry Street. We will wire your window with four incandescent lamps for thirty-five dollars, and supply the current at fifty cents a month. A lit window on a dark street draws custom as a lamp draws moths, and costs less than a boy with a handbell.
event.reporter_calls.title: A Reporter Calls
event.reporter_calls.body: Doing a Sunday piece on the medicine men of the East Side: who they are, what they brew, what it does. I'd like to see your back room for ten minutes, smoke one of your cigars and ask three questions. No tricks, or anyhow no more than the job requires.
event.reporter_calls.choice.show_him: Show him the back room and answer the questions.
event.reporter_calls.choice.pay_him: Give him five dollars, and a bottle for his editor.
event.reporter_proofs.title: Proofs of Sunday's Piece
event.reporter_proofs.body: You showed me the door, and the desk took that for an answer. The proofs of Sunday's piece are enclosed. The desk has given it the head POISON ON MULBERRY STREET? with the question mark, which is the most I could do for you. Twenty-five dollars would buy a different head and the question mark both, and I would see the desk got its share.
event.reporter_proofs.choice.pull_the_ad: Write to his editor that your advertising will go elsewhere.
event.reporter_proofs_paid.title: Proofs of Sunday's Piece
event.reporter_proofs_paid.body: Your five dollars bought me a dinner, and your bottle bought the editor a headache, but neither of them bought the piece. The proofs of Sunday's piece are enclosed. The desk has given it the head POISON ON MULBERRY STREET? with the question mark, which is the most I could do for you. Twenty-five dollars would buy a different head and the question mark both, and I would see the desk got its share.
event.reporter_proofs_paid.choice.pull_t: Write to his editor that your advertising will go elsewhere.
event.reporter_kind.title: Sunday's Piece
event.reporter_kind.body: The piece ran Sunday and you came out of it better than the rest: 'the one druggist on the East Side who would show a reporter what is in his jug, and did not appear to be ashamed of it.' The desk wants a follow-up on the cures. Have you any patients who would talk?
event.reporter_kind.choice.send_patients: Send him three regulars who swear by it.
event.reporter_kind.choice.leave_it: Thank him, and leave it there.
event.stowe_chemist.title: The League's Chemist
event.stowe_chemist.body: The League has had your 'purely vegetable' remedy analysed by a chemist of the College, at a cost of three dollars raised by a bake sale. He finds in it a good deal that never grew in any garden. We propose to print his certificate beside your sheet, unless you can show us the vegetable.
event.stowe_chemist.choice.pay_for_hall: Offer to pay for the League's hall for a year.
event.stowe_chemist.choice.own_chemist: Engage a chemist of your own to find it vegetable.
event.stowe_petition.title: A Petition to Albany
event.stowe_petition.body: You answered our sheet honestly, which no other druggist in the ward did. The League is petitioning the Legislature for a law that every bottle shall say what is in it. A druggist's name at the head of the petition would be worth a hundred of ours, and would cost you, we fear, the good opinion of your trade.
event.stowe_petition.choice.sign_first: Put your name at the head of the petition.
event.proprietary_invite.title: The Proprietary Association
event.proprietary_invite.body: The Association represents the proprietors of the leading family medicines of the country, and watches on their behalf every bill in every legislature that would oblige a proprietor to print his formula, which is to say his property. Membership is twenty-five dollars a year. Members' remedies are defended; others' are left to the Legislature.
event.proprietary_invite.choice.decline: Decline: your property can look after itself.
event.red_clause.title: The Red Clause
event.red_clause.body: Members are advised to add the following to every advertising contract, in red ink: 'It is agreed that this contract shall be void if any law is passed restricting the manufacture or sale of proprietary medicines.' An editor who stands to lose your advertising takes a broad view of such laws, and the Association finds that most editors do.
event.red_clause.choice.add_clause: Add the red clause to your contracts.
event.cholera_1892.title: Cholera at Quarantine
event.cholera_1892.body: Asiatic cholera having appeared among passengers held at Quarantine, the Board directs that no druggist shall sell or advertise any preparation as a preventive or cure of cholera, the public being sufficiently alarmed. Druggists are requested to post the enclosed notice on the boiling of drinking water, and to report every case of purging to the Sanitary Bureau.
event.cholera_1892.choice.cholera_card: Put a card in the window: A SURE PREVENTIVE OF CHOLERA.
event.cholera_1892.choice.post_notice: Post the Board's notice on boiling the water.
event.magazine_household.title: The Household Page
event.magazine_household.body: As you will have read, the Monthly no longer accepts medical advertising, out of regard for our readers' homes. Our Household Page, however, is pleased to mention useful household cordials, and a tonic syrup taken by the spoonful before meals is a household cordial in the meaning of the page. The mention is twenty dollars.
event.magazine_household.choice.househol: Become a household cordial for twenty dollars.
event.magazine_household.choice.decline: Decline: your remedy is medicine or it is nothing.
event.panic_relief.title: The Men Out of Work
event.panic_relief.body: Since the failures in the summer, one man in three in this ward is out of work. The Committee gives tickets to families in want, for bread, coal and medicine, and asks druggists to honour the medicine ticket at cost. We cannot pay you; we can only tell the families which shops did.
event.panic_relief.choice.honour_tickets: Honour the tickets at cost through the winter.
event.panic_relief.choice.decline: Decline: the shop is not a charity.
event.panic_credit.title: Credit Is Stopped
event.panic_credit.body: The banks having suspended currency payments, we are obliged to ask our customers to settle their accounts in cash by the fifteenth of next month. Those who cannot may continue on credit at a tenth over list until the panic passes, which our senior partner estimates at six months and our junior partner at never.
event.panic_credit.choice.on_credit: Carry on, at a tenth over list.
event.lexow_subpoena.title: The Senate Committee
event.lexow_subpoena.body: The Committee has before it the book of a precinct wardman, in which your name appears against certain sums. You are requested to attend on Friday and state what those sums were paid for, and to whom. Witnesses who attend and speak fully are not, as a rule, the subject of further proceedings.
event.lexow_subpoena.choice.testify: Attend, and say what you paid and to whom.
event.lexow_subpoena.choice.catskills: Take a month's rest in the Catskills.
event.sunday_closing.title: The Sunday Law
event.sunday_closing.body: The new Police Board is enforcing the excise law and my doors are shut from Saturday midnight to Monday. A druggist may sell spirits for medicine, and a druggist's back room is not my back room. I can send you thirsty men every Sunday who will want a medicinal glass of your bitters, and I will take a nickel a glass for the sending.
event.sunday_closing.choice.sunday_bitte: Sell bitters by the glass on Sundays.
event.sunday_closing.choice.by_the_bottl: Sell by the bottle only, as the law allows.
event.sunday_closing.choice.keep_sabbath: Keep the Sabbath, and the shutters.
event.wheelmen.title: The Wheelmen
event.wheelmen.body: Our forty members ride to Coney Island and back every Sunday, weather permitting, and come home wanting an embrocation for the knees and a tonic for the rest. If you will supply both at a club price, a dime off the bottle, the club will recommend your shop in the club-room and wear your name on the road.
event.wheelmen.choice.decline: Decline: the shop does not ride.
event.trolley_cards.title: Cards in the Cars
event.trolley_cards.body: The Third Avenue line runs by cable now, and forty thousand passengers a day ride under our cards with nothing to do but read them. A card in every car of the line, changed monthly, is four dollars a month. A passenger who has read your card forty times will believe it, or will at least have nothing else to think of.
event.bicycle_face.title: Bicycle Face
event.bicycle_face.body: I have identified in my practice a new affliction among ladies who ride the wheel: a set, anxious, wind-burned expression, which I have named the Bicycle Face and believe to be permanent. I am preparing a paper on it. A remedy endorsed in that paper would do very well, and my fee for the endorsement is fifteen dollars.
event.bicycle_face.choice.endorsement: Pay the fifteen dollars, and be endorsed in his paper.
event.bicycle_face.choice.get_off: Write that the cure is to get off the bicycle, and charge nothing.
event.state_chemist.title: The State Analyst's Report
event.state_chemist.body: In the course of the Board's inquiry into proprietary medicines, a bottle of your remedy was bought at a druggist's in Troy and analysed in this office. The analysis will be printed in the Board's annual report, which is read by physicians, editors and, increasingly, juries. Any observations you wish to make before it goes to the printer will be considered.
event.state_chemist.choice.observations: Send courteous observations, and something for the analyst's trouble.
event.state_chemist.choice.let_it_print: Let it go to the printer.
event.lodging_house.title: The Lodging-House Keeper
event.lodging_house.body: I keep a house of two hundred beds on the Bowery, and the men in the ten-cent rooms sleep badly and fight. A spoon of something soothing in the evening coffee would save me the cost of a watchman. I would take it by the gallon, no labels, and pay on the first of the month, no questions on either side.
event.lodging_house.choice.by_the_gallon: Sell it to him by the gallon.
event.lodging_house.choice.hire_a_watchm: Tell him to hire the watchman.
event.tammany_back.title: The Organisation Is Back
event.tammany_back.body: The reformers are out and the Organisation is back in the Hall, and it has a longer memory than the Senate. The Sanitary Bureau has a list of shops to look at this spring and yours is high on it. It could be lower. A hundred dollars to the district club would do it.
event.tammany_back.choice.to_the_papers: Send his letter to the Gazette.
event.volunteers_1898.title: The Volunteers at Camp Black
event.volunteers_1898.body: Half the boys in Company G are from your street, and they leave for Tampa next week. The camp water is bad and the camp surgeon has nothing but quinine and opinions. The company would take a gross of your tonic for the voyage, at the soldier's price, which is whatever the soldier has left after his uniform.
event.volunteers_1898.choice.as_a_gift: Send a crate as a gift, with a flag on it.
event.volunteers_1898.choice.at_cost: Let them have it at cost.
event.volunteers_1898.choice.cannot_spar: Write that the shop cannot spare it.
event.army_contract.title: A Contract for the Army
event.army_contract.body: The Department will want a camp tonic for the troops in the South, and I am in a position to see that it is yours. I bottle it at Tampa under your label, from your receipt, and pay a royalty of two cents the bottle on four thousand bottles. I require only your certificate that the tonic prevents camp fever, a form of words the Department finds reassuring.
event.army_contract.choice.sign_certific: Send the receipt and sign the certificate.
event.army_contract.choice.decline: Decline: you do not know what prevents camp fever.
event.army_inquiry.title: The Commission of Inquiry
event.army_inquiry.body: Witnesses before this Commission have described the camp tonic supplied at Tampa under your name as 'chiefly whisky, and bad whisky', and the camp fever as not prevented. You are invited to explain the certificate bearing your signature, in person or in writing, before the first of the month.
event.army_inquiry.choice.blame_contract: Go to Washington and lay it at the contractor's door.
event.army_inquiry.choice.write_a_hope: Write that a druggist is not a physician, and meant no more than a hope.
event.army_inquiry.choice.say_nothing: Say nothing, and let the contractor answer.
event.farm_wife.title: From a Farm in Ohio
event.farm_wife.body: The carrier brings us a New York paper now, and your advertisement is in it. My husband drinks, and when he drinks he is not himself, and I have read that there are drops a wife can put in his coffee without his knowing. If your remedy is that kind I will send a dollar, which is the egg money, and pray, and not tell him.
event.farm_wife.choice.send_drops: Send her the drops, and keep the egg money.
event.farm_wife.choice.write_honestly: Write back that your remedy will not cure a husband, and keep the dollar out of it.
event.testimonial_broker.title: Testimonials by the Hundred
event.testimonial_broker.body: We supply letters of cure in the sufferer's own hand, signed and dated, for any remedy and any complaint, at five dollars the hundred. All names are genuine and most of the writers are living. For a dollar extra we include a clergyman.
event.testimonial_broker.choice.buy_hund: Buy a hundred, with the clergyman.
event.testimonial_broker.choice.decline: Decline: your customers write their own.
event.heroin_traveller.title: A Traveller from a German House
event.heroin_traveller.body: Our principals in the Rhine Province have brought out a new derivative of morphine for coughs, which does everything morphine does for a cough and is not, they assure us, habit-forming in the least. To introduce it we will supply all your opiates at a third under list for a year, provided you give the new article a fair trial in your cough bottle.
event.heroin_traveller.choice.decline: Decline: you have heard 'not habit-forming' before.
event.letter_broker.title: Letters Bought and Sold
event.letter_broker.body: Proprietors receive many letters from sufferers describing their complaints in detail. These letters, of no further use to you, are of great use to other proprietors, who learn from them exactly whom to write to and about what. I pay three dollars the thousand, and am discreet.
event.ice_trust.title: The Price of Ice
event.ice_trust.body: Owing to the consolidation of the companies, ice will this season be delivered at sixty cents the hundredweight, in hundred-pound lots only; the five-cent piece is discontinued. We regret any inconvenience to the poor, who were the chief buyers of the five-cent piece.
event.ice_trust.choice.pay_the_price: Pay the new price, and keep the fountain running.
event.ice_trust.choice.jersey_ice: Buy from a Jersey iceman who cuts it from the Hackensack.
event.ice_trust.choice.shut_fountain: Shut the fountain for the summer.
event.cut_rate.title: The Cut-Rate Stores
event.cut_rate.body: The cut-rate stores on Sixth Avenue and the Bowery are selling your remedy, bought through a jobber, at two-thirds of your price, as bait to bring in custom. The Association asks proprietors to sign the direct-contract plan: sell only to druggists who keep your price, and cut off the jobbers who supply the cutters. The dues are thirty dollars.
event.cut_rate.choice.sign_plan: Sign the plan, and pay the dues.
event.cut_rate.choice.let_them_cut: Let them: a sale is a sale.
event.grimsby_belt.title: Dr. Grimsby Proposes a Partnership
event.grimsby_belt.body: Every man who buys my Belt wants something to drink while it works, and every man who buys your tonic wants something to wear while it works. Let us recommend each other in our circulars: a bottle with every Belt, a Belt with every dozen bottles. Your customers will feel the current, mine will feel the tonic, and both of us will feel the difference.
event.tenement_dept.title: The Tenement House Department
event.tenement_dept.body: An inspector of this Department reports a still and open spirit in the rear room of your premises, which form part of a tenement house under the Act of 1901. A still is a fire in waiting under forty families. You are directed to make the room fireproof within thirty days, or show cause.
event.tenement_dept.choice.fireproof: Have the rear room lined with brick and tin.
event.tenement_dept.choice.ask_inspector: Ask the inspector whether thirty days could be sixty, and sixty never.
event.bureau_sample.title: A Request from the Bureau of Chemistry
event.bureau_sample.body: The Bureau is examining the composition of proprietary remedies in connection with legislation before Congress, and requests that you forward two bottles of your remedy, as sold, for analysis. The Bureau notes that bottles forwarded by proprietors are, as a class, remarkably free of alcohol.
event.bureau_sample.choice.special_batch: Send two bottles from a special batch, mostly water.
event.bureau_sample.choice.from_the_shel: Send two bottles from the shelf.
event.radium_water.title: Radium
event.radium_water.body: Radium, the wonder of the age, gives off energy without end, and so, under licence, will your tonic. For forty dollars we grant you the right to print RADIO-ACTIVE on your label, with our certificate that your bottles have stood a day beside our radium. We do not put radium in the bottles. Radium is far too dear.
event.radium_water.choice.buy_licence: Buy the licence: RADIO-ACTIVE on the label.
event.radium_water.choice.decline: Decline: your tonic gives off quite enough.
event.motor_car.title: A Motor-Car in the Window
event.motor_car.body: Our client regrets that his motor-car, having taken fright at a horse, entered your shop window on Tuesday last. He offers twenty dollars in full settlement for the glass and the bottles, on the understanding that his name is not mentioned to the newspapers, in whose columns he prefers to appear in other connections.
event.motor_car.choice.settle: Take the twenty dollars, and say nothing.
event.motor_car.choice.tell_the_gazette: Tell the Gazette everything, and leave the hole in the window.
event.subway_signs.title: Signs in the Subway
event.subway_signs.body: The new subway carries a quarter of a million passengers a day underground, where there is nothing to look at but the walls. The walls are ours. An enamelled sign on the platforms at Spring Street and Canal Street for twelve months is twelve dollars a month.
event.subway_signs.choice.take_signs: Take the signs for a year.
event.muckraker.title: A Writer for a National Weekly
event.muckraker.body: I am preparing a series on the patent-medicine trade for a national weekly, and am writing to every proprietor whose advertisement I have clipped, which is every proprietor. I should like your formula, a list of your testimonial writers with their present addresses, and your reply to the charge that your remedy is chiefly a means of selling spirits to the temperate.
event.muckraker.choice.send_formula: Send the formula and the addresses.
event.muckraker.choice.libel_letter: Have a lawyer write that any mention will be met in court.
event.reporter_returns.title: An Old Friend at a Magazine
event.reporter_returns.body: You'll remember me from the Clarion, and the question mark. I'm at a national weekly now, and the weekly is going after the nostrum men in earnest, and it pays better for the truth than you ever did. I still have my notes from the old days, and a note of your twenty-five dollars. I'd hate to waste either.
event.reporter_returns.choice.pay_again: Send a hundred dollars, for old times' sake.
event.reporter_returns.choice.give_a_riv: Give him the name of a rival with worse in his jug.
event.reporter_returns.choice.let_him: Let him write what he likes.
event.ama_council.title: The Council on Pharmacy and Chemistry
event.ama_council.body: The Council is preparing a list of proprietary preparations which physicians may prescribe in good conscience. No preparation will be admitted whose formula is not disclosed in full, or whose advertising claims to cure what cannot be cured. You are invited to submit your formula and your advertising for examination.
event.ama_council.choice.submit: Submit the formula and the advertising.
event.ama_council.choice.decline: Decline: your formula is your property.
event.pa_war_chest.title: A Fund for the Committee Room
event.pa_war_chest.body: The bill now before Congress would oblige every proprietor to print upon his label the alcohol and the narcotics in his remedy. The Association is raising a fund to see that the bill is better understood in committee. Your share is assessed at one hundred and fifty dollars.
event.red_clause_called.title: Invoking the Red Clause
event.red_clause_called.body: Members should now write to every paper in which they advertise, drawing the editor's attention to the clause in red ink and to the bill before Congress. Several editors have already seen the light. Members are asked not to put anything in writing that they would not like to see in a magazine, which has lately happened.
event.red_clause_called.choice.write_edi: Write to every editor you pay.
event.congress_member.title: From the Member for the District
event.congress_member.body: The Member is giving the closest attention to the food and drug bill, and would value the views of the proprietors of his district, whose industry he has always admired. He would also value a contribution to the district campaign fund, the fall being nearer than it looks. The two are not connected, the Member asks me to say.
event.congress_member.choice.contribute: Send a hundred dollars, and your views against the bill.
event.congress_member.choice.for_the_bil: Write that you favour the bill, and send nothing.
event.stowe_washington.title: Mrs. Stowe, in Her Eightieth Year
event.stowe_washington.body: I am in my eightieth year and still Secretary, as no one younger will take the minutes. The committee in Washington is hearing witnesses on the food and drug bill, and I am to speak for the League. I have kept every sheet the druggists of this ward filled in for me, yours among them, the one honest line on any of them, and I mean to tell the committee about all of them, as I have known them for twenty years. I write to ask what you would like me to say about you.
event.stowe_washington.choice.go_with_he: Offer to go with her, and say what is in your bottle.
event.stowe_washington.choice.donation: Send the League a donation, with your respects.
event.stowe_washington.choice.let_her_sa: Let her say what she knows.
event.stowe_washington_vegetable.title: Mrs. Stowe, in Her Eightieth Year
event.stowe_washington_vegetable.body: I am in my eightieth year and still Secretary, as no one younger will take the minutes. The committee in Washington is hearing witnesses on the food and drug bill, and I am to speak for the League. I have kept every sheet the druggists of this ward filled in for me, yours among them, with PURELY VEGETABLE written across it in your hand, and I mean to tell the committee about all of them, as I have known them for twenty years. I write to ask what you would like me to say about you.
Offer to go with her, and say what is in your bottle.
Send the League a donation, with your respects.
Let her say what she knows.
event.label_lawyer.title: The New Label
event.label_lawyer.body: From January next the Act requires that every label declare any alcohol, morphine, opium, cocaine, heroin, eucaine, chloroform, cannabis, chloral or acetanilide in the bottle. It does not require the declaration to be large, legible, or on the front. We have drawn a label that complies with the letter of the Act in six-point type on the underside of the bottle, and offer it at seventy-five dollars.
event.label_lawyer.choice.plain_label: Have the printer set it plainly, on the front.
event.label_lawyer.choice.wait_and_see: Wait and see what the inspectors do.
event.food_not_drug.title: A Food, Not a Drug
event.food_not_drug.body: Several of my clients propose to escape the drug clauses of the new Act by calling their remedies foods: a tonic is a beverage, a beverage is a food, and the Act asks less of a food. The opinion of counsel is divided, which is to say expensive. For thirty dollars I will draw the papers that make your remedy a nourishing table beverage.
event.food_not_drug.choice.become_food: Pay thirty dollars to become a table beverage.
event.food_not_drug.choice.stay_medicine: Remain a medicine, and take the consequences.
event.still_smell.title: The Smell from the Back Room
event.still_smell.body: I make bonnets next door, and every bonnet I made this month smells of your still, and a lady from Washington Square sent hers back. Either you put a pipe up through the roof like a Christian, or I go to the Board of Health, who I am told are partial to a complaint in writing.
event.still_smell.choice.put_up_pipe: Put a pipe up through the roof.
event.still_smell.choice.buy_bonnet: Buy the returned bonnet, and ask her to be patient.
event.still_smell.choice.let_her_complai: Let her write to the Board.
event.apprentice.title: An Apprentice
event.apprentice.body: I am in my second year at the College of Pharmacy and must serve my time in a shop. I can weigh to a grain, read a Latin label and keep a poison book, and I ask four dollars a month, which is what the other students get and less than they are worth. I should want to see what goes into everything I make.
event.apprentice.choice.take_him_on: Take him on for a year.
event.apprentice.choice.no_room: Write that the back room has no room.
event.sign_painter.title: A Gilt Sign
event.sign_painter.body: Your sign was painted, I think, by the man on Canal street who does them while you wait, and it says DRUGS in letters that are giving up already. For twelve dollars I will make you a sign in gold leaf on black that can be read from the Bowery, with your name and a mortar and pestle. A man reads a sign before he reads a newspaper.
event.sign_painter.choice.touch_up: Have him touch up the old one for two dollars.
event.sign_painter.choice.leave_it: Leave it: everyone knows where the shop is.
event.burglary.title: A Break-in
event.burglary.body: Your back window was forced on Sunday night and the till taken, with two gallons of spirit. The spirit we found, in the possession of a party now in the Tombs, who had drunk the most of it. The till is believed to be with a fence in Hester street, and for a consideration toward the Department's expenses it might be found.
event.burglary.choice.consideration: Pay the consideration, and get the till back.
event.burglary.choice.bars: Write off the till, and put iron bars on the window.
event.sweatshop.title: A Contractor's Order
event.sweatshop.body: I have sixty girls at the machines on piece work, and by four o'clock they are slow and by six they are crying, which spoils the work. A tonic that kept them at it till nine would pay for itself by the gross. I would put it in the water pail, and the girls need not be troubled with the label.
event.sweatshop.choice.sell_by_gross: Sell it to him by the gross.
event.sweatshop.choice.refuse: Tell him the girls are tired because they are tired.
event.gentleman_morphine.title: A Gentleman Writes in Confidence
event.gentleman_morphine.body: I am a man of some position, and my physician, who is a fool, has stopped my morphia. I understand that a discreet druggist may supply a 'cough remedy' by messenger, in a plain wrapper, at a price that reflects his discretion. Name the price. Do not write to this address; the messenger will call.
event.gentleman_morphine.choice.supply: Name a price, and send the messenger back with a parcel.
event.gentleman_morphine.choice.refer_hi: Send the messenger back with the name of a doctor who treats the habit.
event.revenue_stamp.title: The Internal Revenue
event.revenue_stamp.body: Information has reached this office that your preparation is sold and drunk as a beverage, in which case it is a spirit and you are a retail liquor dealer, liable to the special tax of twenty-five dollars a year. A preparation sufficiently medicated to be undrinkable is not taxed. The Collector leaves the choice of remedy to you.
event.revenue_stamp.choice.see_deputy: Ask the Deputy whether a smaller sum would satisfy the Collector.
event.revenue_stamp.choice.dispute: Write that your preparation is a medicine, and undrinkable.
event.pushcart.title: A Pushcart
event.pushcart.body: I sell lemons, collar buttons and shoelaces from my cart on Bayard Street, and every day people ask me for something for the cough. For fifty cents a month I will send every one of them to your shop, and tell them you are a doctor. I have a licence for the cart, though not, I think, for the last part.
event.pushcart.choice.hire_cart: Pay him the fifty cents a month for six months.
event.photographer.title: Your Likeness
event.photographer.body: A proprietor's likeness on the label sells more bottles than the label does, the public trusting a whisker. I will make your portrait in a frock coat, with a book, for five dollars, and engrave it for the label free of charge. Clean-shaven gentlemen may borrow the whiskers.
event.photographer.choice.sit_for_it: Sit for the portrait, whiskers and all.
event.photographer.choice.decline: Decline: your face is not your fortune.
event.obituary_desk.title: A Question from the City Desk
event.obituary_desk.body: We are told that the late subject of Thursday's paragraph on Elizabeth street took your remedy to the end, and we are inclined to say so in the next edition, the public having an appetite for such details. Our advertising department reminds me that it would be glad of more of your custom, and asks me to mention it.
event.obituary_desk.choice.buy_space: Buy a little space, and the paragraph is forgotten.
event.obituary_desk.choice.write_denial: Write a denial for them to print beside it.
event.phrenologist.title: The Phrenologist Upstairs
event.phrenologist.body: I read the bumps on the heads of thirty persons a week, at my parlour upstairs, and tell each one his character by them. I find in a good many a deficiency of the organ of Vitality, here, behind the ear. I could prescribe your tonic for it, if you would allow me a dime on the bottle. A man who has had his head read will believe anything for a week.
event.phrenologist.choice.decline: Decline: your head is quite full.
event.school_principal.title: From the Grammar School
event.school_principal.body: Several of my boys have come to class asleep, and one sang. They tell me they buy your remedy by the spoonful at a penny a spoon from an older boy, who buys it by the bottle at your counter. I do not suppose you knew this. I write so that you will.
event.school_principal.choice.no_boys: Sell no more to boys, and tell the older one so.
event.school_principal.choice.smaller_bo: Sell the older boy a smaller bottle.
event.clerk_applies.title: A Young Lady Who Keeps Books
event.clerk_applies.body: I have finished the course at a business college on Fourteenth Street, and can keep books by double entry, write a fair round hand, and work the typewriter at forty words a minute, though I see you have no typewriter. I ask three dollars a month and a stool. I have been told that a druggist's back room is no place for a young lady, and should like to judge that for myself.
event.clerk_applies.choice.decline: Write that the back room is no place for a young lady.
event.clerk_books.title: The Books
event.clerk_books.body: I have been through the books. Hobart's have charged you for the same carboy of spirit twice in March and once more in June, which is three dollars and forty cents; I have written to them, and they have found it. There is also a Mr. Dunphy, who has had credit since before I came, owes four dollars, has paid nothing, and is the Alderman's cousin, as he tells everyone. I await your instructions about Mr. Dunphy.
event.clerk_books.choice.dun_him: Have her write to Mr. Dunphy, in her best hand.
event.clerk_leaves.title: Miss Pruitt Gives Notice
event.clerk_leaves.body: I am to be married in June to Mr. Hutchins of the insurance office, who says a married woman does not keep books, though his mother keeps his. I should be glad of a character from you, setting out what I have done here. May I recommend my cousin, Miss Agnes Pruitt, who has just finished the same course, and does not mind the still either.
event.clerk_leaves.choice.hire_cousin: Write her a handsome character, send a wedding present, and engage Miss Agnes.
event.clerk_leaves.choice.character_only: Write her a handsome character, and send a wedding present.
event.lodge_invite.title: Proposed for Membership
event.lodge_invite.body: Brother Rourke has proposed your name and Brother Lynch has seconded it, and the lodge will ballot on Wednesday. The initiation is five dollars and the dues a quarter a month, which provides a doctor in sickness, a band at your funeral, and the custom of a hundred and forty brothers, who are bound by their obligation to buy from one another. The regalia is extra.
event.lodge_invite.choice.join: Be balloted for, and buy the regalia.
event.lodge_invite.choice.decline: Decline: you are not a joiner.
event.lodge_brother.title: A Brother in Distress
event.lodge_brother.body: The bearer is Brother Tierney of our lodge, who has been out of work since the cooperage closed, and whose wife has the rheumatism in her hands. I remind you of the obligation of the fourth degree, which you took, regarding a brother in distress. He will tell you the rest himself, and give you the grip, which you will know.
event.lodge_brother.choice.slate: Give Mrs. Tierney what she needs, on the slate, until he is working.
event.lodge_brother.choice.one_bottle: Give him one bottle of the liniment, and the grip.
event.lodge_brother.choice.refuse: Tell him the fourth degree did not mention the slate.
event.lodge_supper.title: The Lodge Supper
event.lodge_supper.body: The lodge's annual supper and ball is fixed for the second Thursday in February at the Assembly Rooms, tickets a dollar and a half. The committee has put you down to answer the toast to 'Our Professional Brethren', and to supply the punch, as the Brother who knows most about spirits. The committee would not wish the punch to be medicinal.
event.lodge_supper.choice.punch: Make the punch, and the speech.
event.lodge_supper.choice.ticket: Buy a ticket, and leave the punch to the caterer.
event.lodge_supper.choice.regrets: Send regrets, and a dollar to the band.
event.apprentice_exam.title: The Apprentice Passes
event.apprentice_exam.body: I have passed the examination of the College and am a graduate in pharmacy, with a diploma in Latin which I can read; the year in your back room counted toward it. A druggist on Grand Street has offered me eight dollars a month to manage his shop. I would rather stay in yours at six, if you will put my name on the window under yours; I should still want to see what goes into everything.
event.apprentice_exam.choice.keep_him: Keep him at six, and put his name on the window.
event.apprentice_exam.choice.let_him_go: Give him a dinner and a good character, and let him go.
event.carrier_address.title: The Carrier's Address
event.carrier_address.body: Through summer's dust and winter's sleet / I've laid the Gazette at your feet, / With every murder, fire and fraud / The city furnished, or abroad. / The publisher, a liberal man, / Pays boys as little as he can, / And leaves it to the patron's cheer / To pay the carrier at New Year.
event.carrier_address.choice.dollar: Give him a dollar, and pin the verses in the window.
event.carrier_address.choice.nothing: Tell him you pay the Gazette already.
event.holiday_goods.title: Holiday Goods
event.holiday_goods.body: For the Holiday trade we offer an assortment of fancy goods suited to a druggist's window: cut-glass cologne bottles, plush toilet cases, celluloid hair-brushes, and a perfume called Kiss of the Riviera, which we have from Newark. A case of twelve dozen assorted is five dollars. It will sell itself on the twenty-fourth to husbands who had forgotten.
event.holiday_goods.choice.order_case: Order the case for the window.
event.holiday_goods.choice.decline: Decline: the shop sells medicine, not the Riviera.
event.ward_turkeys.title: The Leader's Christmas Dinner
event.ward_turkeys.body: As every year, the Leader will give a Christmas dinner and a pound of coffee to every family in the district that votes, and to some that cannot vote yet. The merchants of the district are invited to subscribe, and the list of subscribers is read out at the dinner, between the turkey and the speech. The list is also kept.
event.ward_turkeys.choice.subscribe: Subscribe five dollars, and be read out.
event.ward_turkeys.choice.cough_syrup: Send a case of cough syrup for the families.
event.lent_pledge.title: A Question for Lent
event.lent_pledge.body: I am giving up the drink for Lent, and Father Mahon says your tonic is a medicine and I may take it. My wife says it is spirit, because she read it in the League's paper, and that it counts. I would take it kindly if you would write which of them is right, and sign it, as there is a dollar on it. (It counts. — M. Conlon.)
event.lent_pledge.choice.medicine: Write that it is a medicine, and sign it.
event.lent_pledge.choice.it_counts: Write that it counts, and sign it.
event.easter_complexion.title: Before Easter
event.easter_complexion.body: I am to walk out on Easter Sunday with a young man from the Custom House, and I have a freckle on my nose that was not there at Christmas. The girls at the box factory say a druggist will sell arsenic wafers for the complexion, which make a lady pale and interesting. I can pay fifty cents, and would rather be interesting than not.
event.easter_complexion.choice.cold_crea: Mix her a cold cream at cost, and write that the freckle is becoming.
event.easter_complexion.choice.lemon: Write that lemon juice is cheaper, and the young man will not mind.
event.moving_day.title: Moving Day
event.moving_day.body: We are moving on the first of May, the landlord having found a tenant who will pay a dollar more, and my husband has found work at the gas house in Harlem. The old man will take no tonic but yours, and says he will not live in Harlem without it, which I believe. Will you send it up to us by the express each month? We will pay the express.
event.moving_day.choice.send_it: Send it up by the express each month.
event.moving_day.choice.name_druggist: Write her the name of a good druggist in Harlem.
event.moving_debts.title: Debtors Removed
event.moving_debts.body: The first of May has carried six of your book debts, amounting to eleven dollars, to addresses unknown to you but known to us, the cartmen being our friends. We will recover what can be recovered for a third of it, by methods within the law, or near it. We are discreet, except with the neighbours.
event.summer_fans.title: Fans for the Summer
event.summer_fans.body: Every summer the ladies of every church on the East Side fan themselves with an undertaker's name from June to September, and the undertaker is not ungrateful. A gross of palm-leaf fans with your name and your remedy printed on both sides is four dollars. In August, sir, a lady will read anything that moves the air.
event.summer_fans.choice.decline: Decline: the ladies can fan themselves with the undertaker.
event.summer_syrups.title: The Summer Months
event.summer_syrups.body: The Board again calls the attention of druggists to the deaths of infants in the summer months, which last July exceeded those of any other month of the year. The Board's physicians believe the soothing syrups and cordials containing opium to be a cause. The Board requests that such preparations be kept behind the counter in July and August, sold only to persons who ask for them by name, and that mothers be directed to the dispensary.
event.summer_syrups.choice.behind_counte: Put the syrups behind the counter until September.
event.summer_syrups.choice.on_counter: Leave them where the mothers can reach them.
event.fourth_of_july.title: The Fourth
event.fourth_of_july.body: The Committee will give the street a celebration on the Fourth worthy of the day, with a band, a reading of the Declaration, and the best fireworks to be had on credit. The shops of the street are asked for two dollars each. The Committee also asks, as every year, that the druggist keep his door open on the night of the Fourth, with lint and oil, for the fingers.
event.fourth_of_july.choice.two_dollars: Give two dollars, for the band and the rockets.
event.fourth_of_july.choice.open_door: Keep the door open on the night, with lint and oil for the burns.
event.fourth_of_july.choice.shutters: Put up the shutters early, as usual.
event.excursion.title: The Sunday-School Excursion
event.excursion.body: The Sunday school goes up the Hudson on the twenty-second of next month, by barge, to a grove near Yonkers. We take three hundred children, eleven teachers and a barrel of lemonade, and mean to bring back three hundred children, which the committee would consider a success. Will you give a box of sticking-plaster for the cuts, and something for the stomach? Your name would go on the programme.
event.excursion.choice.give_box: Send the sticking-plaster, the stomach drops, and a dollar for the lemonade.
event.excursion.choice.programme: Send a dozen of the tonic for the teachers, with your card for the programme.
event.snow_sidewalk.title: Snow on the Sidewalk
event.snow_sidewalk.body: Your attention is directed to the ordinance requiring the occupant of every building to clear the sidewalk before it of snow and ice, on pain of a fine. A lady fell in front of your premises on Tuesday and has given the policeman your name. The Department does not clear sidewalks; it has not yet cleared the streets.
event.snow_sidewalk.choice.hire_boy: Pay a boy to keep it clear until March.
event.snow_sidewalk.choice.lady_bottle: Clear it yourself, and send the lady a bottle of liniment with your apologies.
event.coal_dealer.title: The Price of Coal
event.coal_dealer.body: The coal roads have met in Philadelphia and agreed that stove coal shall be advanced fifty cents a ton on the first of the month, and fifty cents more when the weather turns. We can put in your winter's coal now at the old price, four dollars cash, or deliver it by the bucket all winter at whatever the roads decide. The roads have not consulted us, or you.
event.coal_dealer.choice.now: Take the winter's coal now, for cash.
event.coal_dealer.choice.bucket: Buy it by the bucket, as the weather goes.
event.calendar_printer.title: Calendars for the New Year
event.calendar_printer.body: A calendar hangs in a kitchen for twelve months and is looked at more often than the husband. We will print five hundred for the coming year, with a chromo of a little girl and a kitten above and your remedy below the months, for six dollars; with the phases of the moon, seven. The little girl and the kitten are the same as the undertaker's, but your name will be different.
event.calendar_printer.choice.order: Order five hundred, without the moon.
event.calendar_printer.choice.decline: Decline: the kitchen has the undertaker's.
event.cloudburst.title: Water in the Cellar
event.cloudburst.body: The storm on Saturday backed the sewer into your cellar to the depth of eighteen inches, as you know, and it is the sewer's fault and not the landlord's or mine. I can pump it out and put a trap on the drain for four dollars. The Department of Public Works will do it for nothing, in the autumn.
event.cloudburst.choice.pump: Have him pump it out and fit the trap.
event.school_prize.title: Closing Exercises
event.school_prize.body: The school holds its closing exercises on the last Friday in June, with recitations, a dialogue, and the Fifth Reader class in tableaux. The tradesmen of the street generally give a prize for the best scholar in some branch: the grocer gives one for arithmetic, and the undertaker, I regret to say, for elocution. Would you give one for Physiology and Hygiene, which this year includes the effects of alcohol upon the system?
event.school_prize.choice.physiology: Give a dictionary for Physiology and Hygiene.
event.school_prize.choice.penmanship: Offer a prize for penmanship instead.
event.choir_lozenges.title: The Choir
event.choir_lozenges.body: The choir is preparing the Messiah for Christmas, and the tenors are hoarse, as tenors are, and the basses, who are not, say it is the tenors' fault. I should be grateful for a box of lozenges for the rehearsals, with nothing in them that would make the tenors louder; the Rector has asked particularly.
event.choir_lozenges.choice.horehound: Send a box of plain horehound lozenges, with your compliments.
event.choir_lozenges.choice.regrets: Send your regrets: the tenors will have to manage.
event.target_excursion.title: The Target Excursion
event.target_excursion.body: The Flynn Guard parades on the fourteenth of next month, forty muskets, a band and the target, to the grove at College Point, where prizes will be shot for. Merchants of the district are asked to give prizes, and their names are carried on the target. Merchants who do not give prizes are not carried on anything, and the Guard passes their windows on the way home.
event.target_excursion.choice.silver_cup: Give a silver cup, four dollars, engraved.
event.target_excursion.choice.case_of_to: Give a case of the tonic as a prize.
event.target_excursion.choice.shutters: Put up the shutters on the fourteenth.
event.labor_day.title: Labor Day
event.labor_day.body: The first Monday in September being a legal holiday, the trades of the district will march in the parade, and ask the shopkeepers whose customers they are to close for the day, as the bosses have. A card for the window is enclosed: CLOSED FOR LABOR DAY. A shop that is open will not be marched past in silence.
event.labor_day.choice.close: Put up the card and close for the day.
event.labor_day.choice.lemonade: Stay open, and sell lemonade to the parade.
event.slate_credit.title: On the Slate
event.slate_credit.body: My husband is laid off at the piano factory until the spring orders come in, which the foreman says is March, and the children's chests are bad. I have always paid cash, as you know. Could you put the syrup and the liniment on the slate until he is taken on again? I will pay it all the first Saturday.
event.slate_credit.choice.slate: Put it all on the slate until March.
event.slate_credit.choice.half: The syrup on the slate, the liniment for cash.
event.wrong_bottle.title: The Wrong Bottle
event.wrong_bottle.body: Your errand boy brought my mother one of your bottles on Thursday when she had sent for the other, and she took two spoons of it before she read the label, the print being small and her eyes not what they were. She is quite well, though she says it was never meant for a cough and she has never had less of one. I return the bottle, and should like the one she sent for, and an assurance that the boy can read.
event.wrong_bottle.choice.apologise: Send the right bottle, an apology, and a pound of tea.
event.wrong_bottle.choice.poison_labels: Send the right bottle, and have the labels printed again, large, each remedy in a colour of its own.
event.horse_order.title: For the Mare
event.horse_order.body: I have a grey mare, Duchess, who pulls the funeral coach and has lost her spirit, and the coachman, who takes your tonic, says it puts the heart into him. I should like a gallon for the mare, at whatever it is by the gallon. If it does for her what it does for him, he says, she will race the hearse home.
event.horse_order.choice.veterinary: Write that the shop does not treat horses, and name a veterinary.
event.thanks_note.title: A Pen-Wiper
event.thanks_note.body: The bottle I had at your counter for our Danny's cough has done what the whole winter would not, and he is back at school, where he is not wanted but must go. I made you the enclosed pen-wiper, which is meant to be a mortar and pestle. I have told my sister on Elizabeth Street, who has a cough of her own and a husband who says nothing works.
event.thanks_note.choice.sample: Send her sister a sample bottle, with your card.
event.thanks_note.choice.thank_her: Send your thanks, and put the pen-wiper on the desk.
event.window_ball.title: A Broken Window
event.window_ball.body: My boy Michael put a baseball through your window on Saturday, from the far side of the street, which his teacher would not believe of him. The glazier says two dollars. I can give you a nickel every Saturday until it is paid, and Michael asks may he have the ball back.
event.window_ball.choice.nickels: Take the nickels, and give Michael the ball.
event.window_ball.choice.send_bill: Send Mr. Cullen the glazier's bill, and keep the ball.
event.bad_note.title: Returned by the Bank
event.bad_note.body: In counting your deposit of Saturday the teller found a two-dollar note on the Merchants' Bank of a town in Ohio, which has not had a Merchants' Bank since 1873. It has been cancelled and is returned herewith, and your account charged. The Secret Service would be glad of a description of the gentleman who passed it, if you remember him, as he has passed several on the street.
event.bad_note.choice.describe: Give the Secret Service man a description of the customer.
