event.bad_note.choice.stand_loss: Stand the loss, and look harder at notes.
event.bottle_boys.title: Your Bottles
event.bottle_boys.body: I have at my shop a sack of your bottles, with your name on the label, which the boys of the ward collect from the ash barrels and the rear yards. I will sell them back to you at a cent each unwashed, or a cent and a half washed, which is less than the glassworks charge. The boys are paid a quarter of a cent a bottle, and are always looking.
event.bottle_boys.choice.unwashed: Buy them back unwashed, and rinse them yourself.
event.ship_chest.title: A Medicine Chest
event.ship_chest.body: The law requires that I carry a medicine chest, and the one I have was filled in 1879 and has since been drunk by the crew. I want it filled again for a voyage of five months, with the usual things and a book of directions. I am told your tonic will answer for most of the usual things, and would take two dozen of it, if so.
event.ship_chest.choice.tonic: Fill it with two dozen of the tonic, and a book of directions in your own hand.
event.ship_chest.choice.dispensatory: Fill it from the Dispensatory, at the Dispensatory's prices.
event.theatre_order.title: A Theatrical Order
event.theatre_order.body: In our new piece, The Druggist's Daughter, or, Saved at the Counter, the villain poisons the heroine in the third act and the hero restores her in the fourth. We require a bottle of poison the actress can drink eight times a week, and a bottle of restorative, which may be the same bottle. Your name on the label would be seen by eleven hundred persons nightly, and we will send you passes.
event.theatre_order.choice.coloured_wate: Send coloured water in a blue POISON bottle, and take the passes.
event.theatre_order.choice.own_tonic: Send your tonic in both bottles, with the label to the gallery.
event.theatre_order.choice.decline: Decline: the shop is not in the theatrical line.
event.history_book.title: Leading Men
event.history_book.body: We are preparing a History of the Sixth Ward and the Lower Wards of New-York, with Biographical Sketches of its Leading Men, in one volume, quarto, gilt. Subscribers of three dollars receive the volume and a sketch of their own life, written by our staff from particulars supplied by the subscriber; for eight dollars, a steel engraving of the subscriber as well. Gentlemen who do not subscribe are not, as a rule, leading men.
event.history_book.choice.sketch: Subscribe for the sketch, and supply the particulars generously.
event.history_book.choice.decline: Decline to be a leading man.
event.fire_insurance.title: The Fire Policy
event.fire_insurance.body: Our surveyor reports a still in your back room, of copper, heated by gas, within four feet of a barrel of spirit, which he measured. Your policy is written for a retail drug store and does not contemplate a distillery. We will continue the risk at double the premium, or not at all; in the latter case we would advise you not to have a fire.
event.fire_insurance.choice.move_barrel: Move the barrel, and ask the surveyor back with a cigar.
event.charity_appeal.title: An Appeal
event.charity_appeal.body: The Society for the Relief of Destitute Seamen's Orphans, under the patronage of the clergy of every denomination (whose names are withheld at their own wish), appeals to the merchants of the Sixth Ward. Two hundred orphans of the sea are clothed and fed by the Society, which is to say by its friends. The bearer will call for your answer on Thursday, and the names of all friends are printed.
event.charity_appeal.choice.give: Send a dollar all the same: it reads beautifully.
event.charity_appeal.choice.sergeant: Send the appeal to the sergeant.
event.doctor_counter.title: Counter-Prescribing
event.doctor_counter.body: A patient of mine with a heart I am watching was prescribed for at your counter on Monday, for what you were pleased to call indigestion, and took your remedy until he could not climb his stairs. Counter-prescribing is the curse of the profession. I ask that you send to the dispensary such cases as you do not understand, which I suspect is most of them.
event.doctor_counter.choice.send_cases: Promise to send him the cases you do not understand.
event.doctor_counter.choice.sharp_reply: Reply that your customers cannot afford his profession.
event.doctor_counter.choice.ignore: Let him write to the Board.
event.tonic_taste.title: Not the Same Bottle
event.tonic_taste.body: The last bottle of the tonic tasted of nothing I could name, and the one before of tar, and the one before that was the right one. I am a man of regular habits and want the same bottle every time. If you have changed the receipt I should like to be told, and if you have not I should like to know what you have changed.
event.tonic_taste.choice.free_bottle: Send him a bottle from a good batch, on the house.
event.tonic_taste.choice.taste_batches: Taste every batch before it is bottled, for three months, and pay a boy to mind the counter.
event.tonic_taste.choice.say_nothing: Say nothing: a man's taste changes too.
event.child_errand.title: Sent with a Jug
event.child_errand.body: Send by the girl a pint of the strong tonic for my back, in the jug, and put it on the slate until Saturday. The saloon will not serve her since the new Captain, and you are a druggist and allowed.
event.child_errand.choice.fill_jug: Fill the jug, and put it on the slate.
event.child_errand.choice.send_home: Send the girl home with the jug empty, and a peppermint.
event.carboy.title: A Carboy in the Street
event.carboy.body: My man dropped your carboy of spirit off the tail of the truck on Monday, it being icy and the carboy being slippery, as carboys are. Hobart's say it was mine when it left their door, and I say it was yours when it reached yours; it was in the street in between. The patrolman stood over the place all Tuesday, looking thoughtful.
event.carboy.choice.lawyer: Have a lawyer write to both of them.
event.carboy.choice.pay: Pay for the carboy yourself, and change truckmen.
event.label_printer.title: A Misprint
event.label_printer.body: I regret that in the last thousand labels the compositor, who is new, has set your remedy as one that CURSES Consumption. Five hundred have gone on bottles already. I will reprint the thousand free, and the compositor has been spoken to. He points out that CURSES is the stronger word, and that nobody reads a label.
event.label_printer.choice.soak_off: Take the reprint, and have a boy soak off the five hundred.
event.label_printer.choice.leave_them: Take the reprint, and sell the five hundred as they are.
event.jobber_rival.title: From Another House
event.jobber_rival.body: Your present house charges you list for senna, gentian and grain spirit, and has done since you opened your account. We will supply the same, of the same quality or better, at eight in the hundred under list, on a trial order of five dollars. We do not name your present house, as we have no wish to disparage the Messrs. Hobart, whom we greatly respect.
event.neighbour_fire.title: Burned Out
event.neighbour_fire.body: The fire on Thursday night burned us out of the front house, but every soul got down the fire escape, thanks be, and the firemen say your shop wall held it. Twelve families are at the station-house and the Sisters', and the children have the smoke in their chests. The tenants have made a list of what they need, and you are on it for syrup and lint, if you can.
event.neighbour_fire.choice.send_all: Send the syrup and lint, and something for the coughs, on the house.
event.agent_paint.title: Clause Nine
event.agent_paint.body: Under clause nine of the lease which Mr. O'Rourke holds from the Estate, and you from Mr. O'Rourke, the shopfront is to be painted every third year at the occupant's charge; it was last painted under President Hayes. Our painter will do it for four dollars, in the Estate's green. The Estate does not wish to be unpleasant, and keeps a lawyer for the purpose.
event.agent_paint.choice.estate_green: Have it done in the Estate's green.
event.agent_paint.choice.own_colours: Have the sign painter do it in your own colours, for six.
event.agent_paint.choice.ignore: Ignore it: the Estate's lawyer is busy.
event.agent_noxious.title: Clause Four
event.agent_noxious.body: The Estate has been informed by a tenant of the upper floors that you distil in the back room, and directs your attention to clause four, which forbids any noxious, offensive or dangerous trade upon the premises. The Estate takes the view that a druggist's still is a druggist's still, if the druggist will say so in writing, and will supply the agent with a bottle each quarter for analysis.
event.agent_noxious.choice.in_writing: Say so in writing, and send the agent his quarterly bottle.
event.agent_noxious.choice.let_them_sue: Write that clause four does not mention druggists, and let the Estate sue.
event.boy_measles.title: The Boy Has the Measles
event.boy_measles.body: Tommy has the measles and the doctor says three weeks, and I am to tell you he is very sorry and the big jug is still a secret. I send his brother Joseph in his place, who is eleven and willing and can carry, but cannot read yet, so please do not send him out with the liniment.
event.boy_measles.choice.pay_both: Keep Tommy's wages going, and pay Joseph too.
event.boy_measles.choice.do_without: Do without a boy for three weeks.
event.wedding_punch.title: For the Wedding
event.wedding_punch.body: My daughter is married on Sunday, and the saloons are shut, and the hall has no licence. I am told a druggist may sell spirit for medicinal purposes, and with a hundred and twenty guests some of them will certainly be ill. I would take three gallons of whatever you call it, and a doctor's prescription, if you can get one.
event.wedding_punch.choice.three_gallons: Sell him three gallons of Wedding Cordial, medicinal.
event.wedding_punch.choice.port: Send a bottle of good port as a wedding present, and nothing for sale.
event.wedding_punch.choice.decline: Decline, and wish the couple well.
event.perfume_copy.title: A Paris Scent
event.perfume_copy.body: My customers ask for the Paris perfume that is in all the magazines, at four dollars the flacon, which they cannot pay and I cannot get. A druggist, I am told, can make anything smell like anything. I would take a gallon of something that smells like it, at a price that would let me sell it for a dollar, and put it in little bottles myself, with a little French on the label.
event.perfume_copy.choice.essence_of_par: Make her a gallon of Essence of Paris, from bergamot and spirit.
event.perfume_copy.choice.plain_label: Make it, but label it plainly: Mulberry Street Violet.
event.sealer.title: Weights and Measures
event.sealer.body: On inspection of your premises on Wednesday the counter scale was found to weigh one ounce in the pound in favour of the house, and the half-ounce weight to be a quarter-ounce weight with ambitions. The scale must be adjusted and sealed by this office before it is used again. Fees as per schedule.
event.sealer.choice.adjust: Have the scale adjusted and sealed.
event.sealer.choice.look_again: Give the deputy a quarter to look again.
event.sealer.choice.dispute: Write that the scale was your predecessor's.
event.night_bell.title: At Two in the Morning
event.night_bell.body: Our Annie took the croup at two on Sunday morning, and I ran down and knocked at your door until the policeman came, and then ran to Grand Street, where there is a night bell. She is better now, thank God. I write to ask whether you would put in a night bell like his, for the street, as croup does not keep shop hours.
event.night_bell.choice.put_in_bell: Put in a night bell, and sleep in the back room.
event.night_bell.choice.shop_hours: Write that the shop keeps hours, and name the Grand Street man.
event.jury_duty.title: A Summons
event.jury_duty.body: You are summoned to sit on a jury at the Court of General Sessions on the first Monday of next month, and to remain in attendance for two weeks. Excuses are heard by the Commissioner on Tuesdays. The Commissioner's clerk is understood to be sympathetic to men of business, at a dollar.
event.jury_duty.choice.serve: Serve your two weeks, and leave the counter to a neighbour's boy.
event.pedestal_fund.title: The Pedestal Fund
event.pedestal_fund.body: The statue of Liberty lies in its crates on Bedloe's Island for want of a pedestal, and the rich men of the city have given less than the newsboys. A newspaper prints the name of every giver, if it is only a cent. The Committee asks that a box be kept on your counter until August, and that you put the first dime in it yourself, where the customers can see.
event.pedestal_fund.choice.box_and_dolla: Keep the box on the counter, and put in a dollar.
event.pedestal_fund.choice.box_and_dime: Keep the box on the counter, and put in the dime.
event.pedestal_fund.choice.decline: Decline: the French gave it, the French can stand it up.
event.centennial_1889.title: The Centennial
event.centennial_1889.body: On the thirtieth of April the city keeps the hundredth year of General Washington's inauguration, with a parade of the army and navy, the schools, and the trades, and every house on the line of march is to be dressed. Mulberry Street is not on the line of march, but the Committee feels it should look as if it were. Bunting is fourteen cents the yard from the Committee, which has bought a good deal of it.
event.centennial_1889.choice.dress_shop: Buy twenty yards and dress the shop.
event.centennial_1889.choice.washington: Put a portrait of Washington in the window, with a bottle at his elbow.
event.centennial_1889.choice.nothing: Leave the shop as it is.
event.trade_cards.title: Trade Cards
event.trade_cards.body: Every child in the city keeps an album of picture cards, and begs them at every counter, and a mother who has given your card to her child will see it every evening for a year. We will print a thousand chromo cards, a different flower on each, with your name and remedy on the back, for three dollars. The flowers are the same as the corset-maker's, but the back is yours.
event.trade_cards.choice.decline: Decline: you have seen the albums.
event.census_1890.title: The Census of Manufactures
event.census_1890.body: You are required to return the enclosed schedule of manufactures for the census year, stating the capital invested, the hands employed, the wages paid, and the quantity and value of products. The returns are confidential and used for statistical purposes only. Under 'kind of product' you may wish to be precise: several druggists of your ward have returned themselves as manufacturing chemists, two as distillers, and one as a physician.
event.census_1890.choice.truthfully: Return it truthfully: patent medicines, so many gallons of spirit.
event.census_1890.choice.chemist: Return yourself as a manufacturing chemist, with modest figures.
event.columbus_1892.title: The Four Hundredth Year
event.columbus_1892.body: On the twelfth of next month the city keeps the four hundredth year of the discovery of America, and the societies of the district will march with their banners from Mulberry Street to the Circle, where the monument our people paid for by subscription is to be unveiled. The Committee asks the shops of the street to light their windows on the night. It will lend lanterns at ten cents each.
event.columbus_1892.choice.lanterns: Light the window with the Committee's lanterns.
event.columbus_1892.choice.march: Shut the shop and march with the druggists.
event.columbus_1892.choice.own_lamp: Light the window with your own lamp.
event.fair_medal_1893.title: A Gold Medal
event.fair_medal_1893.body: Your remedy has been entered, at our own expense, in the Bureau's exhibit of American Proprietary Medicines at the Exposition, and has been awarded the Bureau's Gold Medal of the First Class. A facsimile in bronze, suitable for the label, will be forwarded on receipt of eight dollars for the engraving. The Bureau's medals are not to be confused with the Exposition's own, which have not yet been struck.
event.fair_medal_1893.choice.buy_medal: Send the eight dollars: GOLD MEDAL, CHICAGO 1893.
event.fair_medal_1893.choice.decline: Decline: you were not in Chicago, and neither was your remedy.
event.phonograph.title: The Talking Machines
event.phonograph.body: Our machines play the latest songs, a cornet solo and a sermon, for a nickel, through ear-tubes. We propose to have an elocutionist speak an advertisement for your remedy between the songs, at three dollars a month. A listener cannot put down the tubes in the middle, as he has paid.
event.phonograph.choice.record: Have the elocutionist speak for you, for six months.
event.phonograph.choice.decline: Decline: the shop speaks for itself.
event.settlement_nurse.title: From the Visiting Nurse
event.settlement_nurse.body: I visit a family on your street where the father has been in bed with his back since the winter, and takes your tonic by the bottle; he says it is the only thing that lets him sleep. He takes nothing else, eats very little, and the children go without to buy it. I do not ask you to refuse him, since he would go elsewhere. I ask you to tell me what is in it, so that I know what I am nursing.
event.settlement_nurse.choice.tell_her: Tell her exactly what is in it, and how much.
event.settlement_nurse.choice.small_bott: Sell him only the small bottle, and tell the nurse so.
event.settlement_nurse.choice.trade_secr: Write that the receipt is a trade secret.
event.antitoxin_1895.title: The Antitoxin
event.antitoxin_1895.body: The Board now prepares diphtheria antitoxin in its own laboratory, and will supply it free to the poor through its inspectors. Its physicians report that it saves most of the children it reaches in time. The Board asks druggists to send every case of sore throat with a membrane to a physician at once, and to remove from their windows any preparation sold as a cure for diphtheria.
event.antitoxin_1895.choice.send_them: Keep the throat cures out of the window, and send the cases to the doctors.
event.antitoxin_1895.choice.keep_card: Put a card in the window: SURE CURE FOR SORE THROAT.
event.white_wings.title: Ashes, Garbage and Rubbish
event.white_wings.body: Under the new rules of the Department, ashes, garbage and rubbish are to be kept in separate receptacles and set out separately, and the Department's men in white will collect them, which has not always been the case before. Your rear yard has been observed to contain a barrel of mixed ashes, broken bottles, and something the inspector declined to name. Your compliance is requested by Monday.
event.white_wings.choice.three_barrels: Buy two more barrels, and sort it.
event.white_wings.choice.tip_cartman: Give the cartman a quarter to take it as it is.
event.white_wings.choice.leave_it: Leave it for the rats, as before.
event.bicycle_boy.title: A Wheel for Deliveries
event.bicycle_boy.body: The boy at the Grand Street druggist's has a bicycle, and delivers to Fourteenth Street and back before I am at the Bowery, and he gets the custom of the up-town doctors. A good second-hand wheel is five dollars from a man on Canal Street who does not say where he got it, or eight from the store, which does.
event.bicycle_boy.choice.store_wheel: Buy the wheel from the store.
event.bicycle_boy.choice.canal_street: Buy the wheel on Canal Street.
event.x_rays_1896.title: The New Photography
event.x_rays_1896.body: The new rays which see through flesh have been the talk of the world since the winter, and the public will pay to see the bones of its own hand. I propose to set up my apparatus in your window for a month, at no charge to you, and to tell every person who has seen his bones that your tonic will put flesh back on them. I would ask a third of the tonic sold.
event.x_rays_1896.choice.accept: Let him set up in the window.
event.x_rays_1896.choice.decline: Decline: the ward can keep its bones to itself.
event.gold_clause_1896.title: Payable in Gold
event.gold_clause_1896.body: In view of the agitation for the free coinage of silver, and the possibility that the November election may change the value of money, we must ask that all accounts opened or renewed with us after the first of the month be made payable in gold coin of the present standard. Customers who sign the enclosed agreement will be charged the usual prices. Others will be charged the usual prices and a tenth, against the risk of Mr. Bryan.
event.gold_clause_1896.choice.silver_car: Refuse, and put a silver card in the window.
event.raines_law.title: Now a Hotel
event.raines_law.body: Under the new law a hotel may serve drink on Sundays with a meal, and a hotel is anything with ten bedrooms, so I have put ten beds upstairs and a sandwich on the bar, which the gentlemen do not eat; it is the same sandwich since April. Now that I am a hotel, I could sell your tonic at the bar on Sundays, with the sandwich, at a nickel the glass, and send you half.
event.raines_law.choice.decline: Decline: the tonic is not a beverage, whatever the Collector says.
event.school_inspector.title: From the Medical Inspector
event.school_inspector.body: The medical inspector of the school on your street has excluded forty-one children this month for pediculosis, and their mothers have been directed to the druggists of the street for a lotion. The Department's formula is enclosed; it costs about four cents the bottle to make. The Department hopes it will not cost the mothers forty.
event.school_inspector.choice.at_cost: Make the Department's lotion, and sell it at cost.
event.school_inspector.choice.nursery_lo: Sell your own Nursery Lotion at forty cents.
event.school_inspector.choice.usual_prof: Make the lotion, at the usual profit.
event.consolidation_1898.title: The Greater City
event.consolidation_1898.body: Under the charter of the greater city, which took effect on the first of January and now takes in Brooklyn, Queens, Richmond and the Bronx, every licence, permit and registration issued by the former city is to be renewed on the forms of the new one, of which a great many have been printed. The fee is one dollar. Applications made through the district leader's office are said to be handled faster, and cost two.
event.consolidation_1898.choice.pay_doll: Fill in the forms and pay the dollar.
event.consolidation_1898.choice.district: Send it through the district leader's office, for two.
event.consolidation_1898.choice.wait: Wait: the new city cannot find its own forms.
event.war_stamps_1898.title: The War Stamp
event.war_stamps_1898.body: Under the War Revenue Act, from the first of July every bottle of a proprietary medicine sold at retail must bear an adhesive stamp, according to its price. Stamps may be had at this office. The Department has been informed that a stamp may be removed from an empty bottle with steam, and wishes it known that it has been informed.
event.war_stamps_1898.choice.stamp_all: Buy the stamps, and stamp every bottle.
event.war_stamps_1898.choice.steam_them: Buy one sheet, and steam the stamps off the empties.
event.war_stamps_1898.choice.no_stamps: Sell without stamps, and wait for the Deputy.
event.telephone.title: A Telephone
event.telephone.body: A telephone on your counter would put you in communication with most of the physicians of the city, who would rather telephone a prescription than write one. The instrument is installed for ten dollars and rented at a dollar a month. The druggist on Grand Street who has one says he cannot remember how he lived without it, and that it rings at three in the morning.
event.liquid_air.title: Liquid Air
event.liquid_air.body: Liquid air, sir, is the power of the coming century: it freezes, it boils, it drives an engine, and a gentleman of our company has made ten gallons of it with three. Shares are offered to a few men of business at five dollars, to be worth a hundred when the works are built. Medical men believe it will cure consumption, and the company would value a letter from a druggist saying so, for the prospectus; for which it would pay three dollars.
event.liquid_air.choice.testimonial: Write the letter, for the three dollars.
event.liquid_air.choice.decline: Decline: the shop has cures enough of its own to sell.
event.subway_digging.title: The Street Is Opened
event.subway_digging.body: The work of the rapid transit railroad will open Elm Street from curb to curb for some months, and your street will carry the carts, the spoil and the horses. Merchants who find their trade reduced may apply to the Board of Rapid Transit Railroad Commissioners, which has no funds for the purpose. We will lay a plank bridge to your door for two dollars, which is not usual.
event.smallpox_1901.title: Smallpox
event.smallpox_1901.body: Smallpox being present in the city, the Department will vaccinate without charge any person who applies at its offices, or to its vaccinators, who are visiting the tenement houses of your ward this month. Druggists are requested to post the enclosed notice. The Department has learned that certain druggists are selling a smallpox preventive to be taken by the spoon, and wishes them to know that it has learned it.
event.smallpox_1901.choice.post_notice: Post the notice in the window.
event.smallpox_1901.choice.preventive: Sell the preventive, by the spoon or the bottle.
event.trading_stamps.title: Trading Stamps
event.trading_stamps.body: With every ten cents' purchase your customer receives a stamp, and with nine hundred and ninety stamps pasted in our book, a parlour lamp, a set of dishes or a Morris chair. The merchant pays the company two cents a stamp, and the customer, who might have bought elsewhere, buys of the merchant who gives stamps. Every grocer on the street has joined but one, who has not been well.
event.trading_stamps.choice.decline: Decline: your customers want the tonic, not the chair.
event.motorist.title: Out of Gasoline
event.motorist.body: My machine has stopped outside your shop for want of gasoline, the garage being on Fifty-ninth Street and I being on Mulberry. I am told druggists keep benzine for cleaning gloves. If you will sell me two gallons of it I will pay a dollar a gallon, which is robbery, and tell the Club that you are on the road.
event.motorist.choice.for_the_road: Sell him the benzine, and a bottle of tonic for the road.
event.motorist.choice.send_for_horse: Tell him the benzine is for gloves, and send for a horse.
event.postcards.title: A View of the Shop
event.postcards.body: Everyone is sending picture post cards, and the ladies keep them by the album. We will photograph your shop front, with yourself in the door, and print a thousand cards for five dollars, which your customers will send to every relation in Ohio. A druggist's window is a view.
event.postcards.choice.cards: Order a thousand cards, and stand in the door.
event.postcards.choice.decline: Decline: the relations in Ohio buy by post already.
event.electric_sign.title: A Sign in Lights
event.electric_sign.body: On Broadway a sign now spells out its message one letter at a time, and the crowd waits to see how it ends. We will put above your door a sign of sixty lamps that spells your remedy, letter by letter, and then all at once, for twenty dollars and a dollar a month for the current. The effect, we are told, is mesmeric.
event.electric_sign.choice.decline: Decline: the shop is not on Broadway.
event.nickelodeon.title: Animated Pictures
event.nickelodeon.body: We open on Saturday with The Great Train Robbery and a lady who sings between the reels. Between the songs we show lantern slides of the merchants of the street, with their goods, at a dollar a month; the hall is dark, and the audience cannot look anywhere else. We also find the audience has a great many headaches.
event.nickelodeon.choice.slide: Take a slide, with the headache powder on it.
event.nickelodeon.choice.decline: Decline: the street has headaches enough.
event.burglary_book.title: The Detective Sergeant's Book
event.burglary_book.body: Your till was found in Hester street, as I said it might be, and you have it back. I keep a book, as every man in the Department does, and your name is in it against the consideration, which is usual. The Captain has run his eye down the book this month, and asks me to say that the friends of the Department are expected at his steamboat outing, at five dollars, and that he does not forget a friend.
event.burglary_book.choice.subscribe: Send the Captain five dollars, as a friend of the Department.
event.burglary_book.choice.out_of_the_bo: Ask the sergeant what it costs to have your name taken out of the book.
event.burglary_book.choice.for_the_till: Write that the consideration was for the till, and for nothing else.
event.thanks_sister.title: From Mrs. Quaid's Sister
event.thanks_sister.body: My sister Mrs. Quaid gave me the sample bottle you sent round with your card. My husband, who says nothing works, took the whole of it to prove so, and says it did nothing, and that his cough is no worse, which he does not count. He would like another bottle, so as to be sure.
event.thanks_sister.choice.another: Send him another bottle, on the house.
event.thanks_sister.choice.sell_one: Sell him a bottle at the price, as a man who knows his own mind.
event.thanks_sister.choice.believe_him: Write that a man who says nothing works should be believed, and save his money.
event.bad_note_trial.title: Before the Commissioner
event.bad_note_trial.body: On the description you were good enough to give, the party who passed the note on the Merchants' Bank of Ohio has been taken on the Bowery with forty more of them sewn into his coat. He is to be examined before the United States Commissioner on Thursday, and you are requested to attend and identify him. A witness is allowed a dollar a day, which is less than a druggist's day, as the Service is aware.
event.bad_note_trial.choice.not_sure: Write that you would not know him again.
event.carrier_address_new.title: The New Carrier's Address
event.carrier_address_new.body: Through summer's dust and winter's sleet / My brother walked this very beat; / He drives the Gazette's wagon now, / And I have got his bag, and bow. / The paper's cheaper than of yore, / The publisher is paid the more, / And leaves it, as he did, to cheer / To pay the carrier at New Year.
event.carrier_address_new.choice.dollar: Give him a dollar, and pin the verses in the window.
event.carrier_address_new.choice.nothing: Tell him you pay the Gazette already.
